lines.text: Normally, I struggle to stay interested in a novel; however, this one had me entranced. This is my first experience reading Shari Lapena, and I am absolutely floored by this book's ability to keep me up at night theorizing about what will happen next. If you need a book that will not only grab your attention but will also fully absorb you into the pages, pre-order this captivating thriller!
